theme_strategy.rationale: A clean, dark 'trading terminal' aesthetic requires a dark-first environment to reduce eye strain during long sessions and prioritize fast, scannable data visualization.

hierarchy.disclaimer_banner: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold

rules: Use Azeret Mono for all numerical data, tickers, and prices to ensure tabular alignment.
Use IBM Plex Sans for descriptive body text, tooltips, and standard paragraphs.
Never default to bold for headers; use varied weights like Light or Black for tension.
No pure black (#000000). Always use tinted darks.
Color is Function Only: 90% of the UI should be monochrome. Use Green/Red exclusively for market direction and profit/loss.
Use warning yellow (#FFE600) exclusively for the 'Not Financial Advice' banner and critical alerts.

surfaces.name: Grid Borders (Technical Look)
surfaces.usage: Dashboard data panels and strategy cards
surfaces.css: border border-border/40 bg-card rounded-none or rounded-sm shadow-none

textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to break pure digital flatness.
rules: Avoid heavy gradients. Use 1px solid borders to separate regions.
No Glassmorphism. Trading terminals need optical clarity, not blur.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Tightly packed for data (p-3 to p-4 inside panels), but generous macro spacing (gap-4).
rules: Use 'border-collapse' style or tight 1px gaps between panels for a Bloomberg-terminal feel.
Keep the 'Signals are not financial advice' banner sticky at the absolute top of the viewport.

overrides.cards: Remove default large border-radii. Use rounded-sm (2px) or sharp edges. Remove drop-shadows. Rely on 1px borders.
overrides.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm), high contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black).
overrides.tables: Dense rows, tabular numbers (font-mono), explicit right-alignment for numerical columns.
overrides.toggles: Custom styled switch for Strategy On/Off. Green when active, muted grey when off.

libraries: lightweight-charts or recharts (for Candlestick and Equity curve charting)

rules: Micro-interactions only. Hover states must be instant or very fast (0.1s).
New signals in the feed should flash briefly (e.g., bg-green-500/20 to transparent) to draw attention.
No bouncy or sweeping layout animations. Keep it rigid and professional.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Gray text must be light enough against the dark background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='strategy-toggle-rsi').

login_hero.description: Abstract streaks of blue and red light for the login page background.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup the layout with a sticky warning banner at the top: 'SIGNALS ARE NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE'. Style it with a yellow background and black text for high urgency.
2. Build the main dashboard using a strict grid layout. Left/Center side should house the main Signal Feed and Chart. Right side should house Strategy Configuration Cards.
3. Use a lightweight charting library (e.g., lightweight-charts by TradingView or Recharts) to render the candlestick price charts and equity curves.
4. For strategy configuration, build compact, dense cards with On/Off switches (Shadcn Switch) and metric displays (Expectancy, Win Rate, Max Drawdown).
5. Use Azeret Mono for all numeric values and table cells. Explicitly right-align numeric columns.
6. Ensure all components use sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm) and rely on 1px borders instead of drop-shadows to achieve the 'terminal' look.
7. Implement a strict dark mode using the provided color palette (page_bg: #0A0A0C). Do not add a light mode.
8. Add `data-testid` attributes to all actionable elements (toggles, buttons, tabs) and key data points.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
